<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
<title></title>
<script src="https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js"></script>
<style>
/* Mini-App „Übersicht" (docs/package-contract.md §3.12). Flaechen/Text aus Telegrams Theme (--tg-theme-*: Hell/Dunkel
   folgt dem Nutzer), Akzente aus docs/site/static/css/site.css. Zustandsfarbe nie allein: jede Pill/jeder Banner traegt
   ein Icon, Beschriftung immer in Textfarbe (teal/gelb sind als Schrift auf Weiss zu kontrastarm). */
:root {
  --bg: var(--tg-theme-secondary-bg-color, #F1F0F5);
  --card: var(--tg-theme-section-bg-color, var(--tg-theme-bg-color, #FFFFFF));
  --text: var(--tg-theme-text-color, #211D1D);
  --hint: var(--tg-theme-hint-color, #847E7E);
  --head: var(--tg-theme-section-header-text-color, var(--tg-theme-hint-color, #847E7E));
  --sep: var(--tg-theme-section-separator-color, #E6E6E6);
  --active: var(--tg-theme-accent-text-color, var(--tg-theme-link-color, #6D6AF0));
  --accent: #6D6AF0;
  --ok: #39BEB7;
  --warn: #FFB400;
  --alert: var(--tg-theme-destructive-text-color, #E5484D);
  --radius: 16px;
  --font: -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --safe-b: var(--tg-safe-area-inset-bottom, env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-scheme="light"]) {
    --bg: var(--tg-theme-secondary-bg-color, #18181B);
    --card: var(--tg-theme-section-bg-color, var(--tg-theme-bg-color, #232326));
    --text: var(--tg-theme-text-color, #F4F4F5);
    --hint: var(--tg-theme-hint-color, #A1A1AA);
    --head: var(--tg-theme-section-header-text-color, var(--tg-theme-hint-color, #A1A1AA));
    --sep: var(--tg-theme-section-separator-color, #2E2E33);
    --active: var(--tg-theme-accent-text-color, var(--tg-theme-link-color, #9896FF));
    --accent: #9896FF;
  }
}
:root[data-scheme="dark"] { --accent: #9896FF; }

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); }
body {
  font: 16px/1.4 var(--font);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  padding: 12px 16px calc(24px + var(--safe-b));
}
body.has-tabs { padding-bottom: calc(80px + var(--safe-b)); }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; background: none; border: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; text-align: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--active); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }
.ic { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

.st-ok { --st: var(--ok); }
.st-warn { --st: var(--warn); }
.st-alert { --st: var(--alert); }
.st-neutral { --st: var(--hint); }
.bar.st-neutral { --st: var(--accent); }

#app { transition: opacity .15s; }
body.loading #app { opacity: .45; }
#app:empty::after {
  content: ""; display: block; width: 28px; height: 28px; margin: 38vh auto 0;
  border: 3px solid var(--sep); border-top-color: var(--accent); border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin .8s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

.title { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 4px 4px 12px; }

.hero {
  background: var(--card); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 18px 20px 20px; margin-bottom: 12px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 var(--accent);
}
.hero-label { color: var(--hint); font-size: 14px; }
.hero-value {
  font-size: clamp(30px, 9vw, 40px); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15;
  margin-top: 4px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.hero-note { color: var(--hint); font-size: 13px; margin-top: 6px; }

.banner {
  position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%;
  background: var(--card); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px 12px 18px; margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.banner::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 5px; background: var(--st); }
.banner-tx { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.sec { margin-top: 20px; }
.sec-title {
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--head); margin: 0 4px 8px;
}
.card { background: var(--card); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.sec-empty { margin: 0; padding: 14px 16px; color: var(--hint); }
.list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.item { padding: 12px 16px; }
.item + .item { border-top: 1px solid var(--sep); }
.row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; }
button.row:active, button.banner:active { opacity: .6; }
.left { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.label { font-weight: 500; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sub { color: var(--hint); font-size: 13px; margin-top: 2px; }
.right { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px; flex-shrink: 0; max-width: 55%; }
.value { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.chev { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--hint); }

.pill {
  position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  padding: 2px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--st); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500;
}
.pill::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--st); opacity: .22; }
.pill .ic { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

.bar { height: 6px; margin-top: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg); overflow: hidden; }
.bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--st); }

.gap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: var(--hint); font-size: 12.5px; margin-top: 4px; }

.center { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 18px; margin-top: 30vh; text-align: center; }
.big { font-size: 40px; line-height: 1; }
.retry {
  width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; text-align: center;
  background: var(--tg-theme-button-color, #6D6AF0); color: var(--tg-theme-button-text-color, #FFFFFF);
}
.refusal { padding: 20px; margin: 30vh 0 0; text-align: center; }

#tabs {
  position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex;
  background: var(--card); border-top: 1px solid var(--sep);
  padding: 6px 4px calc(6px + var(--safe-b));
}
#tabs[hidden] { display: none; }
.tab {
  flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px;
  padding: 4px 2px; color: var(--hint); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; text-align: center;
}
.tab[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--active); font-weight: 600; }
.tab-ic { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.1; }
.tab-tx { max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  #app { transition: none; }
  #app:empty::after { animation: none; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main id="app" aria-live="polite"></main>
<nav id="tabs" hidden></nav>
<script>
function uiRender(B, LANGS) {
  B = B || {};
  LANGS = LANGS || {};
  const T = B.t || {};
  const loc = B.locale || 'en-GB';
  // fn_ui_texts liefert fuer einen fehlenden Key den Key selbst -> das zaehlt hier als "nicht vorhanden".
  const has = (k) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(T, k) && T[k] !== k;
  const t = (k) => (has(k) ? T[k] : String(k));
  const empty = has('core.fmt.empty') ? T['core.fmt.empty'] : '—';
  const isEmpty = (v) => v === null || v === undefined || v === '';
  // Platzhalter in EINEM Durchlauf: einfache Werte unveraendert (auch '' fuer optionale Zusaetze wie die Einheit),
  // nur typisierte Werte ({kind: money|date|enum|...}) laufen durch val(); null/undefined -> ''. Ein FEHLENDER
  // Parameter zaehlt wie undefined: n8n verwirft undefined-Felder beim Speichern des Summary-Objekts, sonst stuende
  // Rohtext wie "{isin}" auf der Karte (Owner 2026-10-22). Vertippte Parameter-Namen faengt der Build
  // (Assert-HitlTplParams in New-HitlLine/New-HitlNote/New-HitlSummary).
  function fill(txt, params) {
    return String(txt).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (m, n) => {
      if (!params || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(params, n)) return '';
      const p = params[n];
      if (p === null || p === undefined) return '';
      return (typeof p === 'object') ? val(p) : String(p);
    });
  }
  function money(v, c) {
    if (isEmpty(v)) return empty;
    const n = Number(v);
    if (!isFinite(n)) return String(v);
    // Ohne gueltigen Waehrungscode KEIN stilles EUR (ein USD-Betrag sahe sonst wie Euro aus): Zahl + Rohcode.
    if (!(typeof c === 'string' && /^[A-Za-z]{3}$/.test(c))) return num(v, 2) + (isEmpty(c) ? '' : ' ' + String(c));
    const cur = c.toUpperCase();
    try { return Number(n).toLocaleString(loc,{style:'currency',currency:(/^[A-Za-z]{3}$/.test(cur)?cur:'EUR'),currencyDisplay:'narrowSymbol'}); } catch (e) { return String(v) + ' ' + cur; }
  }
  function date(v) {
    if (isEmpty(v)) return empty;
    try { return ((m) => m ? new Date(Date.UTC(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3])).toLocaleDateString(loc, {timeZone:'UTC', year:'numeric', month:'2-digit', day:'2-digit'}) : String(v))(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(String(v))); } catch (e) { return String(v); }
  }
  // Nachkommastellen, die der Wert selbst traegt (ohne Null-Schwanz der DB, z. B. numeric(18,8) "10.00000000" -> 0).
  function decimals(v) {
    const s = String(v).trim();
    const e = s.match(/^-?\d+(?:\.(\d+))?e-(\d+)$/i);
    if (e) return Math.min(20, (e[1] || '').length + Number(e[2]));
    const m = s.match(/\.(\d+)$/);
    return m ? Math.min(20, m[1].replace(/0+$/, '').length) : 0;
  }
  // digits < 0 = so viele Stellen wie der Wert hat (Stueckzahlen: Krypto bis 8 Stellen, nie gerundet).
  function num(v, digits, sign) {
    if (isEmpty(v)) return empty;
    const n = Number(v);
    if (!isFinite(n)) return String(v);
    const d = (Number(digits) < 0) ? decimals(v) : Math.max(0, Math.min(6, Number(digits) || 0));
    try { return n.toLocaleString(loc, { minimumFractionDigits: d, maximumFractionDigits: d, signDisplay: sign ? 'exceptZero' : 'auto' }); }
    catch (e) { return String(v); }
  }
  function val(x) {
    if (isEmpty(x)) return empty;
    if (typeof x !== 'object') return String(x);
    if (Array.isArray(x)) return x.length ? x.map(val).join(', ') : empty;
    const v = x.value;
    switch (x.kind) {
      case 'money': return money(v, x.currency);
      case 'date': return date(v);
      case 'number': return num(v, x.digits, x.sign);
      case 'enum': {
        if (isEmpty(v)) return empty;
        const k = String(x.enum) + '.' + String(v).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]+/g, '_');
        return has(k) ? T[k] : String(v);
      }
      case 'bool': return (v === true || v === 'true') ? t('core.fmt.yes')
        : ((v === false || v === 'false') ? t('core.fmt.no') : empty);
      case 'language': return isEmpty(v) ? empty : (LANGS[v] || String(v));
      case 'key': return isEmpty(v) ? empty : (has(v) ? T[v] : (x.fallback || String(v)));
      case 'tpl': return isEmpty(v) ? empty : fill(t(v), x.params);
      case 'removed': return t('core.fmt.removed');
      case 'list': return (Array.isArray(v) && v.length) ? v.map(val).join(', ') : empty;
      default: return isEmpty(v) ? empty : (Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(', ') : String(v));
    }
  }
  function msg(parts) {
    return (Array.isArray(parts) ? parts : [parts]).filter((p) => !isEmpty(p)).map(val).join(' ');
  }
  function lines(ls) {
    return (Array.isArray(ls) ? ls : []).map((l) => (l === null || l === undefined) ? ''
      : (Array.isArray(l) ? msg(l) : val(l))).join('\n');
  }
  return { T, loc, has, t, empty, isEmpty, fill, money, date, num, val, msg, lines };
}
</script>
<script>
// Mini-App-Shell: kennt kein Paket, rechnet nichts. Navigation + Bildschirme kommen als View-Modell v1 von
// core.fn_app_screen (POST an dieselbe URL); jedes {kind:…}-Objekt rendert uiRender(ui).val(), rohe Strings
// (Kontonamen aus Importen) gehen nur per textContent ins DOM, nie über einen HTML-Parser (XSS, contract_lint 29b). Keine sichtbaren Literale:
// alle Texte aus ui.t, bei Netzfehler nur ⚠ + ↻. Kein Storage (opaker Origin der n8n-Sandbox).
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const TG = (window.Telegram && window.Telegram.WebApp) || null;
  const ENDPOINT = location.href.split('#')[0].split('?')[0];
  const SVG = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const STATES = ['ok', 'warn', 'alert', 'neutral'];
  const ICONS = {
    check: ['M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5'],
    alert: ['M12 3.5L2.5 20h19L12 3.5z', 'M12 10v4.5', 'M12 17.2v.1'],
    calendar: ['M4.5 6.5h15v13h-15z', 'M4.5 10.5h15', 'M8.5 3.5v4', 'M15.5 3.5v4'],
    clock: ['M12 3.5a8.5 8.5 0 1 0 0.01 0z', 'M12 7.5V12l3 2.5'],
    pause: ['M9 6.5v11', 'M15 6.5v11'],
    info: ['M12 3.5a8.5 8.5 0 1 0 0.01 0z', 'M12 11v5.5', 'M12 7.8v.1'],
    chev: ['M9.5 6l6 6-6 6']
  };
  const app = document.getElementById('app');
  const tabs = document.getElementById('tabs');
  let navR = null;
  let lastUi = null;
  let current = null;
  let stack = [];
  let seq = 0;

  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    const e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined && text !== null) e.textContent = String(text);
    return e;
  }
  function clear(node) { while (node.firstChild) node.removeChild(node.firstChild); }
  function icon(name, cls) {
    const paths = ICONS[name];
    if (!paths) return null;
    const svg = document.createElementNS(SVG, 'svg');
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 24');
    svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    svg.setAttribute('class', cls || 'ic');
    paths.forEach((d) => {
      const p = document.createElementNS(SVG, 'path');
      p.setAttribute('d', d);
      svg.appendChild(p);
    });
    return svg;
  }
  const stateOf = (s) => (STATES.indexOf(s) >= 0 ? s : 'neutral');
  const txt = (R, x) => (typeof x === 'string' ? x : R.val(x));
  const isTarget = (t) => !!(t && typeof t === 'object' && typeof t.screen === 'string' && t.screen);

  function scheme() {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-scheme', (TG && TG.colorScheme) || '');
  }
  function busy(on) {
    app.setAttribute('aria-busy', on ? 'true' : 'false');
    document.body.classList.toggle('loading', !!on);
  }
  function setLang(ui) {
    if (ui && typeof ui.lang === 'string') document.documentElement.lang = ui.lang;
  }
  function updateBack() {
    if (!TG || !TG.BackButton) return;
    if (stack.length) TG.BackButton.show(); else TG.BackButton.hide();
  }

  function post(body) {
    const payload = Object.assign({ init_data: (TG && TG.initData) || '' }, body);
    return fetch(ENDPOINT, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      cache: 'no-store'
    }).then((r) => {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(String(r.status));
      return r.json();
    }).then((j) => {
      if (!j || typeof j !== 'object') throw new Error('shape');
      return j;
    });
  }

  function showNetError(retry) {
    clear(app);
    const box = el('div', 'center');
    box.appendChild(el('div', 'big', '⚠'));
    const b = el('button', 'retry', '↻');
    b.type = 'button';
    const R = lastUi ? uiRender(lastUi, {}) : null;
    if (R && R.has('core.app.reload')) b.setAttribute('aria-label', R.t('core.app.reload'));
    b.addEventListener('click', retry);
    box.appendChild(b);
    app.appendChild(box);
  }

  function showRefusal(resp) {
    const R = uiRender(resp.ui, {});
    if (resp.ui) lastUi = resp.ui;
    setLang(resp.ui);
    stack = [];
    updateBack();
    tabs.hidden = true;
    document.body.classList.remove('has-tabs');
    clear(app);
    app.appendChild(el('p', 'card refusal', resp.text ? R.val(resp.text) : R.empty));
  }

  function start() {
    const my = ++seq;
    busy(true);
    post({}).then((resp) => {
      if (my !== seq) return;
      busy(false);
      if (resp.ok !== true) { showRefusal(resp); return; }
      navR = uiRender(resp.ui, {});
      lastUi = resp.ui || lastUi;
      setLang(resp.ui);
      if (navR.has('core.app.title')) document.title = navR.t('core.app.title');
      const screens = Array.isArray(resp.screens) ? resp.screens.filter((s) => s && isTarget(s)) : [];
      renderTabs(screens);
      if (screens.length) { open({ screen: screens[0].screen, params: {} }, true); return; }
      clear(app);
      app.appendChild(el('p', 'card refusal', navR.has('core.app.nothing') ? navR.t('core.app.nothing') : navR.empty));
    }).catch(() => {
      if (my !== seq) return;
      busy(false);
      showNetError(start);
    });
  }

  function open(target, reset) {
    if (!isTarget(target)) return;
    if (reset) stack = [];
    else if (current) stack.push(current);
    current = { screen: target.screen, params: (target.params && typeof target.params === 'object') ? target.params : {} };
    load();
  }
  function back() {
    if (!stack.length) return;
    current = stack.pop();
    load();
  }
  function load() {
    const my = ++seq;
    busy(true);
    updateBack();
    markTab();
    post({ screen: current.screen, params: current.params }).then((resp) => {
      if (my !== seq) return;
      busy(false);
      if (resp.ok !== true) { showRefusal(resp); return; }
      if (resp.ui) lastUi = resp.ui;
      setLang(resp.ui);
      renderView((resp.view && typeof resp.view === 'object') ? resp.view : {}, uiRender(resp.ui, {}));
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    }).catch(() => {
      if (my !== seq) return;
      busy(false);
      showNetError(load);
    });
  }

  function renderTabs(screens) {
    clear(tabs);
    tabs.hidden = screens.length < 2;
    document.body.classList.toggle('has-tabs', !tabs.hidden);
    screens.forEach((s) => {
      const b = el('button', 'tab');
      b.type = 'button';
      b.dataset.screen = s.screen;
      b.appendChild(el('span', 'tab-ic', typeof s.icon === 'string' ? s.icon : ''));
      b.appendChild(el('span', 'tab-tx', txt(navR, s.title)));
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (current && current.screen === s.screen && !stack.length) return;
        open({ screen: s.screen, params: {} }, true);
      });
      tabs.appendChild(b);
    });
  }
  function markTab() {
    const root = stack.length ? stack[0] : current;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(tabs.children, (b) => {
      if (root && b.dataset.screen === root.screen) b.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
      else b.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
  }

  function renderView(v, R) {
    clear(app);
    if (v.title) app.appendChild(el('h1', 'title', txt(R, v.title)));
    if (v.hero && typeof v.hero === 'object') app.appendChild(hero(v.hero, R));
    (Array.isArray(v.banners) ? v.banners : []).forEach((b) => { if (b) app.appendChild(banner(b, R)); });
    (Array.isArray(v.sections) ? v.sections : []).forEach((s) => { if (s) app.appendChild(section(s, R)); });
  }
  function gapNote(R) {
    const g = el('div', 'gap');
    g.appendChild(icon('alert'));
    if (R.has('core.app.gap')) g.appendChild(el('span', null, R.t('core.app.gap')));
    return g;
  }
  function hero(h, R) {
    const box = el('section', 'hero');
    if (h.label) box.appendChild(el('div', 'hero-label', txt(R, h.label)));
    box.appendChild(el('div', 'hero-value', R.val(h.value)));
    if (h.gap === true) box.appendChild(gapNote(R));
    if (h.note) box.appendChild(el('div', 'hero-note', txt(R, h.note)));
    return box;
  }
  function banner(b, R) {
    const go = isTarget(b.target);
    const box = el(go ? 'button' : 'div', 'banner st-' + stateOf(b.state));
    if (go) { box.type = 'button'; box.addEventListener('click', () => open(b.target)); }
    const ic = icon(b.icon);
    if (ic) box.appendChild(ic);
    box.appendChild(el('span', 'banner-tx', txt(R, b.text)));
    if (go) box.appendChild(icon('chev', 'ic chev'));
    return box;
  }
  function section(s, R) {
    const box = el('section', 'sec');
    if (s.title) box.appendChild(el('h2', 'sec-title', txt(R, s.title)));
    const items = Array.isArray(s.items) ? s.items : [];
    if (!items.length) {
      box.appendChild(el('p', 'card sec-empty', s.empty ? txt(R, s.empty) : R.empty));
      return box;
    }
    const list = el('ul', 'card list');
    items.forEach((it) => { if (it) list.appendChild(item(it, R)); });
    box.appendChild(list);
    return box;
  }
  function item(it, R) {
    const li = el('li', 'item');
    const go = isTarget(it.target);
    const row = el(go ? 'button' : 'div', 'row');
    if (go) { row.type = 'button'; row.addEventListener('click', () => open(it.target)); }
    const left = el('div', 'left');
    left.appendChild(el('div', 'label', txt(R, it.label)));
    if (it.sub) left.appendChild(el('div', 'sub', txt(R, it.sub)));
    if (it.gap === true) left.appendChild(gapNote(R));
    const right = el('div', 'right');
    if (it.value !== null && it.value !== undefined) right.appendChild(el('div', 'value', R.val(it.value)));
    if (it.pill && typeof it.pill === 'object') right.appendChild(pill(it.pill, R));
    row.appendChild(left);
    if (right.firstChild) row.appendChild(right);
    if (go) row.appendChild(icon('chev', 'ic chev'));
    li.appendChild(row);
    if (it.progress && typeof it.progress === 'object') li.appendChild(bar(it.progress));
    return li;
  }
  function pill(p, R) {
    const s = el('span', 'pill st-' + stateOf(p.state));
    const ic = icon(p.icon);
    if (ic) s.appendChild(ic);
    if (p.text) s.appendChild(el('span', null, txt(R, p.text)));
    return s;
  }
  function bar(p) {
    const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(p.pct) || 0));
    const t = el('div', 'bar st-' + stateOf(p.state));
    t.setAttribute('role', 'progressbar');
    t.setAttribute('aria-valuemin', '0');
    t.setAttribute('aria-valuemax', '100');
    t.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(pct));
    const f = el('div', 'bar-fill');
    f.style.width = pct + '%';
    t.appendChild(f);
    return t;
  }

  if (TG) {
    try { TG.ready(); TG.expand(); } catch (e) { /* aelterer Client: ohne expand weiter */ }
    try { TG.setHeaderColor('secondary_bg_color'); TG.setBackgroundColor('secondary_bg_color'); } catch (e) { /* vor Bot API 6.9 */ }
    if (TG.BackButton) TG.BackButton.onClick(back);
    if (typeof TG.onEvent === 'function') TG.onEvent('themeChanged', scheme);
  }
  scheme();
  start();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

## Ablauf
**core.main_app_serve — Mini-App „Übersicht“**

Eingang der read-only Telegram-Mini-App (Knopf „📊 Übersicht“ neben dem Eingabefeld). GET liefert die Seite (index.html, ohne Daten). Die Seite schickt per POST {init_data, screen?, params?} als text/plain; App screen reicht den Body als Text an core.fn_app_screen. Dort passiert alles: Telegram-initData per HMAC prüfen (Schlüssel core.app_secret), Person auflösen, Schalter app.enabled/app.audience, Bildschirm aus core.app_screens aufrufen. Der Workflow prüft und rechnet nichts. Der Pfad ist ein Deploy-Platzhalter, deploy_workflows.sh setzt je Instanz eine geheime Adresse ein (INGRESS_ID_KEY). Kein Caddy-Eintrag nötig: /webhook/* ist schon freigegeben.

## Achtung
**Öffentlicher Eingang aus dem Internet**

Jede Anfrage kommt ungeprüft aus dem Internet. Daher: (1) Daten gibt es nur nach bestandener initData-Prüfung in der DB, bei JEDEM Abruf, höchstens 1 h alt. (2) Kein Alarm je Müll-Anfrage: core.fn_app_screen wirft nie, App screen läuft bei einem DB-Fehler weiter (onError), Send data antwortet dann {ok:false}. (3) Keine Ausführungsdaten speichern (saveData*Execution none): initData und Finanzzahlen sollen nicht in der n8n-Historie liegen. (4) Kinder-Sicht und Rollen entscheidet allein die Bildschirm-fn in der DB, nie diese Seite.

## n8n-Eigenheit
**HTML aus einem Webhook läuft im CSP-Sandkasten**

n8n setzt auf jede Webhook-Antwort den Header Content-Security-Policy: sandbox (allow-scripts, aber ohne allow-same-origin; nicht abschaltbar je Workflow). Die Seite hat dadurch einen opaken Ursprung: kein localStorage/Cookie, und ihr fetch an dieselbe Adresse gilt als fremder Ursprung (Origin: null). Darum POST mit Content-Type text/plain (einfache Anfrage ohne Preflight); n8n spiegelt den Origin per Standard-CORS. Den Sandkasten global abzuschalten ist verworfen (CVE-2026-25051). Getestet vom freien App-HTTP-Test.
